business.label: Small business
business.heading: What does your business need?
business.note: A website, an online store, booking, or a tool for stock and orders.

startup.label: Startup or tech team
startup.heading: What are you building?
startup.note: An MVP, an AI feature, or a second opinion on what you already have.

website.label: Website
website.prompt: What do you do, and what should the website help with?

eshop.label: Online store
eshop.prompt: What do you sell, roughly how many products, and do you sell online already?

automation.label: Stock, orders, booking
automation.prompt: What do you keep track of today, and how — paper, Excel, something else?

mvp.label: MVP
mvp.prompt: What are you building, who is it for, and what must the first version do?

ai.label: AI feature
ai.prompt: Which task should AI take off people, and what data does it need?

review.label: Code review
review.prompt: What exists today, and what worries you about it?

form.name: Name
form.errOrg: Please add a company or project name.
form.errEmail: Please add an email we can reply to.
form.errScope: Please describe the task in a sentence or two.
form.idle: This opens your email app with the message ready to send to {{email}}.
form.idleDirect: Goes straight to the team. A person reads every message.
form.privacy: We use these details only to reply to you.
form.errFast: That was quick. Check the form and press Send again.
form.errSend: It did not go through. Open it in your email app, or write to {{email}}.

receipt.title: Almost done
receipt.body: Your email app should open with the message ready. Press Send there — until then nothing reaches us. If nothing opened, copy the message and send it to {{email}}.
receipt.sentBody: {{reply}}, a person from the team will write back to {{email}}.
